plan.title: Removed PR team member hidden from assignee list

steps.note: Enable the required PR team filtering configuration for this case.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area where PR-1 can be selected.
Stay on the Open tab, the only tab where PR assignment actions are available.
Locate PR-1 and select it so its assignment controls become available.

args.goal: With PR-1 selected, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, wait for the Search a user box and user list, type User I's name, and stop with the list showing that User I is not present.

steps.note: Perform the assignment search and verify the removed team member is excluded from the results.
Assert that User I is absent from the displayed assignee search results.
